gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-merriweather-sans: Letters strung out like beads on a long thread give Bruno Ace SC its whole attitude. Merriweather Sans does the quieter job, making lowercase words look sturdy and large, with an e that opens clearly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-syncopate: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-mouthed letters wide, with no calligraphic thinning, while Syncopate keeps a steady, technical-pen line beneath. Large, brief titles are where the heading really sings.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-satoshi: Satoshi feels approachable, with a wide-open e that never looks squeezed shut. Bruno Ace SC spreads its beaded letters across the top, while that lofty x-height gives the lines below a generous lift.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-switzer: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace SC strings its open-mouthed forms out like beads on a thread. Switzer plays the straight man, with wire-like letterforms and c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-epilogue: Epilogue feels curvy and unclamped, with stubby ascender tips. The standout quality is the weight gap: Cherry Swash hits hard with heavy diagonals and a horseshoe c, while Epilogue stays wire-thin.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-fira-sans: The body reads clean and wide-mouthed, a foil for Cherry Swash and its horseshoe c. Fira Sans lets its s curves open at both ends and its x-height run large, giving the heavy diagonals above plenty of room.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-merriweather-sans: Cherry Swash opens its c wide, like a horseshoe, with commanding presence. Merriweather Sans meets it with sturdy, large-looking lowercase, and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-supreme: Cherry Swash flings its c open like a horseshoe and gives its diagonals the same heft as its verticals. Supreme does the crisp work in the text, keeping letters held open.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-satoshi: Satoshi feels approachable, with a wide-open e that never looks squeezed shut. Across a full page, the soaring x-height and uniform strokes keep lines steady, while Cherry Swash handles the commanding part up top.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-switzer: Distinctive from the first glance, Cherry Swash flings its c open like a horseshoe. Switzer handles the quiet end, with wire-like letterforms and a high waist line, while the heading does the shouting.
